title: A Selection Premium Decomposition for the Expected Maximum of Random Walks
summary: When $K$ models are evaluated on the same validation set of size $n$, the selected winner's apparent performance is biased upward. Suppose $K$ models are evaluated on a shared sequence of i.i.d. observations $X_1,\dots, X_n$, where model $k$ achieves response $f_k(X_i)$ with mean $μ_k = \mathbb E[f_k(X)]$.
